DuckDB-native semantic and retrieval relations

Source: R/ducksemantics-package.R
ducksemantics-package.Rd

ducksemantics owns ontology graphs, validated HPO observations, typed release-cataloged Monarch relations, narrow read-only projections of attached dated Monarch packs, provider/snapshot-bound literature retrieval, source-grounded judgments, and genuine model/provider protocols. Bulk values are ordinary relations; evaluation belongs to VariantStoryBench.
